observed: Framed render: at 32px the dome, base bar and three slanted cuts all resolve on light (#F7F7F5) and dark (#161616). At 24px (the stated minimum) the cuts are about 1px and read as texture.
WCAG formula: terracotta #BC4A2D on Brasa #221C18 = 3.33:1, on #161616 = 3.58:1. Both clear the 3:1 non-text floor. The cuts are knockouts and show the dark background.

Wordmark render at 96px and 320px is crisp serif bold on both backgrounds. Terracotta text is large/bold (44 units, weight 700), so 3.33:1 on Brasa and 4.38:1 on Crema pass the 3:1 large-text floor. At 32px it is illegible, which is below the declared 120px minimum.

wordmark.svg uses loaded via , so Source Serif 4 cannot load. It rendered in the fallback (Georgia-like) face. On the sheet it differs from the h1 and the lockup span, which use real Source Serif 4. The README admits the dependence but the asset is not font-stable.
recommendation: Convert the text to outlines, or state in the sheet that the file is a fallback-face stand-in.

observed: Recomputed with the WCAG formula. Terracotta/Crema 4.38 (claimed 4.4), terracotta/Brasa 3.33 (3.3), Tinta/Crema 13.22 (13.2), Crema/Brasa 14.58 (14.6), Tinta/Brasa 1.10 (1.1), Corteza/Crema 5.42 (5.4), Corteza/Brasa 2.69 (2.7). All claims match to rounding.

Terracotta (4.38:1, below the 4.5 small-text floor) appears as text only in the lockup span (2rem, 700) and the wordmark, both large. Small text uses Tinta, Corteza (5.42) or Crema. The palette sheet itself says 'Solo graficos y texto grande'.

The sheet states clear space as half the symbol width per side. A 64px symbol with 32px padding in the dashed box matches. Minimums are 24px for the symbol and 120px for the wordmark. 24/32/64px specimens are shown, with one-color and no-effects rules.

A semicircle over a flat bar with three slashes reads as a hard hat or burger bun, not as a loaf. The brand copy says 'hogaza con tres cortes'. No obvious existing bakery mark was matched, so originality passes.
recommendation: Give the dome an asymmetric or ovoid loaf silhouette and cuts that follow the curve, and drop the separate base bar.

observed: In the sheet, the 'Miga Comun' text in the lockup panels wraps to two lines (light and dark panels at 1440px) because the panel is 260px or narrower with 32px padding. The 4th (dark) panel sits alone on a second row, leaving an empty grid cell.
recommendation: Add white-space:nowrap to .lockup span and size the font to fit, or use a 2x2 grid with 4 equal panels.

observed: README correctly says fixture, hand-authored SVG, CCF generate not run. Its 'Sin verificar' section says render and taste were not run, but both now exist (renders on disk, taste lint run: 0 critical, 0 major, 1 minor). Contrast was hand-computed, and this review found the figures correct.
recommendation: Update the 'Sin verificar' section to the current state.

observed: Taste lint: 1 minor (Google Fonts link). It is permitted by BRIEF as the only external dependency, and the system-font fallbacks are declared.
recommendation: Accepted per BRIEF; optionally self-host the fonts.

observed: One focal point (h1 + symbol). Spacing uses an 8/16/24/32/48/80 scale. 2 typefaces, 1 accent. Phone 390px: overflow_px 0, body 17px, no horizontal scroll. h1 is 2.5rem on phone.
